comment: Every face is part-bound: OLED mirrors SSD1306 GDDRAM, VGA mirrors the physical write-snoop card, and keyboard input becomes PS/2 Code Set 2 frames captured by the VIA.

config.text: Type here—or press any of the 74 keys on the keyboard in the Circuit. The byte crosses PS/2 → capture → VIA PA/CA1 → 6502 firmware → both displays.
